WITH loop_drug_concepts AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (932745, 956874, 942350, 987406) -- bumetanide, furosemide, torsemide, ethacrynate
),
first_loop_use AS (
    SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
    FROM omop.drug_exposure de
    JOIN loop_drug_concepts ldc ON ldc.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
    GROUP BY de.person_id
),
potassium_concepts AS (
    SELECT concept_id AS measurement_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept
    WHERE concept_id IN (
        3023103, -- Potassium [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma
        46235078, -- Potassium [Moles/volume] in Serum, Plasma or Blood
        3005456, -- Potassium [Moles/volume] in Blood
        3043409, -- arterial blood
        3040893, -- capillary blood
        3031219, -- mixed venous blood
        3041354  -- venous blood
    )
),
new_users_with_followup AS (
    SELECT flu.person_id, flu.index_date
    FROM first_loop_use flu
    JOIN omop.observation_period op
      ON op.person_id = flu.person_id
     AND flu.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date
     AND DATEADD(day, 30, flu.index_date) <= op.observation_period_end_date
),
low_k_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT n.person_id
    FROM new_users_with_followup n
    JOIN omop.measurement m
      ON m.person_id = n.person_id
    JOIN potassium_concepts pc
      ON pc.measurement_concept_id = m.measurement_concept_id
    WHERE m.measurement_date >= n.index_date
      AND m.measurement_date < DATEADD(day, 31, n.index_date)
      AND m.value_as_number < 3.5
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS new_loop_diuretic_users_with_30d_followup,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lk.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS users_with_potassium_lt_3_5_within_30d,
    CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN lk.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS decimal(10,2)) AS proportion_percent
FROM new_users_with_followup n
LEFT JOIN low_k_users lk ON lk.person_id = n.person_id;

Among **98,650 new loop-diuretic users** with at least 30 days of follow-up, **26,194** had potassium **< 3.5 mmol/L within 30 days**.

- Outcome window: index date through 30 days
- Potassium labs: serum/plasma/blood potassium measurement concepts with `value_as_number < 3.5`
